questions.question: Why did Hiromi Higuruma pursue a career in law?
questions.subject: Hiromi Higuruma/Synopsis

answer.item: Hiromi found people to be weak and ugly, a depravity that he valued and empathized with, and was the reason why he pursued a career in law

questions.question: How did Hiromi Higuruma gain his cursed technique?
questions.subject: Hiromi Higuruma/Synopsis

answer.item: Kenjaku remotely casted Idle Transfiguration on him, altering his brain and giving him the capacity to awaken his cursed technique

questions.question: How many points had Hiromi Higuruma gained by November 11 of the Culling Game?
questions.subject: Hiromi Higuruma/Synopsis

answer.item: Hiromi had already killed at least twenty players in the Culling Game, gaining a total of 102 points

questions.question: What rule did Hiromi ask the kogane to add to the Culling Game?
questions.subject: Hiromi Higuruma/Synopsis

answer.item: making it possible to transfer points between players

questions.question: What battle plan did Yuji propose for guaranteeing a death penalty for Sukuna?
questions.subject: Hiromi Higuruma/Synopsis

answer.item: redo his own second trial when Judgeman accused him of the massacre at Shibuya and have Sukuna added as a codefendant
